amendment_reason: Replace the rounded lane-union keep-in support with the maximal registered obstacle-free floor. The legacy lane map already removed a 0.32 m semantic keep-out from each storage edge; applying the full rectangular-body gate to that support counted clearance twice. V2 reconstructs the actual registered storage/structure footprints, subtracts every robot-height physical collision AABB, and applies the locked 0.80 x 0.55 m body collision test. V3 removes the unnecessary 0.10 m release margin and retains only a 1 mm numerical guard, so the release gate requires no contact rather than extra clearance. The warehouse, tasks, uncertainty fields, and arm definitions are unchanged.
candidate_generation: Enumerate geometry-valid start-lane, cross-aisle, and goal-lane combinations; remove duplicate collinear vertices and immediate backtracks; retain one distinct route per cross-aisle before filling by geometric length; cap at eight. The set is generated once by the same deterministic geometry-only rule for every arm.

common_feasibility.definition: Static swept rectangular-body clearance is checked against both the driveable-lane union and the complete physical collision scene, including separately included props. Bounded-unicycle swept rollout and terminal-goal reachability at 1.0 m/s must also agree across all four arms.
common_feasibility.optimizer_transition_check: Each enumerated route is converted to bounded stop-turn-go unicycle controls that land exactly on every map-derived waypoint. The full rollout uses the planner's swept rectangular-body validation; release admission independently checks the frozen polyline at 0.04 m.

driveable_geometry.construction: site boundary minus reconstructed storage/structure cores minus runtime physical collision AABBs

execution_gate: Do not launch Gazebo until all selected routes are frozen and the U0-U3 runtime packages bind the same selected visibility-residual correction used to fit R.
purpose: Select one route per current thesis task and uncertainty arm with CasADi before any Gazebo execution.

scientific_design.separate_ablation: U4 joint RGB Gaussian changes both mean and R

selection_rule: Use the same deterministic geometry-derived candidate seed set for every arm; run the full CasADi planner separately per task and arm; freeze each accepted result.
